summary: Build product and supplier emissions data workflows with ISO 14067 exercises. Explore the course and plan your team’s training.
lede: Product carbon footprinting helps sustainability, procurement, quality, and environmental professionals assess life-cycle emissions and manage supplier data. The training supports repeatable product-footprint work through boundary setting, activity-data and emission-factor review, and structured calculations. Participants also develop supplier questionnaires and assemble traceable verification evidence, while keeping product results distinct from organisation-wide inventories.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, review, or use product and supplier emissions data across manufacturing and supply chains.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with sustainability, procurement, environmental data, product operations, or supplier management is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet application for calculation and data-review exercises.
